name: Realm of Dwarrowdelf
game_text:
Plays to your support area.
<phase>Skirmish</phase>: Discard the top 3 cards from your draw deck to make a Dwarf strength +1 (limit +3) and, if underground, <keyword>damage +1</keyword> (limit +3).
